card.fires_on: The last word of a named serious adverse event (bradycardia, anemia, respiratory failure) or a linking word such as 'may', 'can' or 'that' right after one. It appears in warnings and adverse reaction sections of drug labels.

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward the word 'secondary', as in an effect secondary to a cause.
card.plain: It fires at the end of a named serious side effect, where the text may go on to say what it leads to or is caused by.
